title: Recover a Lattice Archive
briefing: The Lattice archives hold pre-collapse deep-reach telemetry. Locate an archive structure and extract a crystal sample before the sentinels lock it down.
fieldGuide: Mid-campaign recovery mission focused on structure exploration.

objectives.label: Enter a Lattice Archive
objectives.detail: Find and enter the buried archive structure.

objectives.label: Recover a Lattice Crystal
objectives.detail: Carry a resonant crystal sample out of the archive.

rewards.label: Hadal Wraith Spawn Egg
rewards.detail: A contained sample of the deepest known predator.

rewards.label: Lattice Crystal
rewards.detail: Additional resonant crystals for crafting or study.

completionText: Lattice archive breached and crystal sample secured. The data patterns point toward the Hadal Trenches.
